profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Rocket Mortgage
profile.summary: Eric is an experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated knowledge and history in Python, SQL, C#, and .NET.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Key Technologies: C#, Javascript/Typescript, .NET Core, Angular, Postgres

● Led successful upgrade of legacy string message stream system to AWS FIFO queues, enabling multi-client subscribers and eliminating message sequencing errors, using Angular and C#.

● Identified and optimized slow and expensive SQL calls that were causing system bottlenecks, leading to a 15% reduction in monthly AWS costs.

● Identified high severity bugs and resolved them while enhancing unit and integration tests to prevent future regression. Delivered accurate and on-time fixes to maximize production experience for end-users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Technologies: C#, Javascript/Typescript, .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server

● Designed and developed a multi-client web application using Angular and C# that analyzes vehicle sales data, boosting clients’ traffic and customer retention by 50%.

● Led team meetings in optimally designing scalable database models using normalization and indexing,
significantly improving data organization and access efficiency.

● Demonstrated adaptability by quickly learning and contributing to adjacent teams’ codebases during peak workloads, boosting their delivery velocity by 15%.

● Established continuous delivery build and release processes in Azure for new projects, eliminating inefficient manual deployment workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key Technologies: Python, SQL

- Developed an automated email service which detects erroneous file data and dynamically contacts business users, reducing hours of manual search time per day.

- Integrated a comprehensive test suite using xUnit into a GM high performance file monitor app, achieving code coverage of 95%+ and significantly reducing occurrences of Sev-1 incidents.

- Succeeded in resolving numerous operations support tickets accurately and on-time, reducing GM worldwide factory downtime by hundreds of hours.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Key Technologies: C#, Javascript, .NET Framework, SQL Server

- Overhauled an aging Webforms app to the latest Angular and .NET versions, drastically improving the UX and productivity of end users.

- Designed and developed an internal developer administration tool, which automated 10+ existing manual
developer workflows.

- Redesigned inefficient database models into optimized and normalized relationships, significantly reducing data redundancy and improving future scalability.

positions.title: Android Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Key Technologies: C#, Xamarin

- Constructed a natural language processing Android app to detect and answer car dealer sales related questions, reducing data access time for dealership employees by over 80%.

- Independently analyzed and researched feasibility and costs vs. benefits of implementing Xamarin, a cutting-edge mobile framework.

- Professionally presented to and influenced development team to utilize Xamarin, cutting development time by 30%
